title: Enga Chinna Rasa
desc: Chinnarasu, a naive boy loves his stepmother dearly and fails to see her evil actions as she takes advantage of him. Later, she plots to kill him for his property.

title: Aatha Naan Pass Ayittaen
desc: Sita, a village officer, tries to expose the atrocities of an evil leader. When he tries to defame her, her lover comes to her rescue and marries her in front of the village.

title: Oru Odai Nadhiyagirathu
desc: A woman becomes pregnant after a man rapes her one night. She, while raising her son, and the man, who marries another woman, search for each other.

title: Sukran
desc: College classmates Ravi and Sandhya are in love with each other. But Sandhya's cruel stepmother wants to marry her off to her uncle, who is a rowdy person willing to go to any extent to stop them.

title: Bharathan
desc: Upon being falsely incriminated for his older brother's murder, Bharath plots revenge against a powerful businessman with the help of three convicts.
